description: tiktok-shop: Shop Search. GET /v1/tiktok/shop/search. Products on TikTok Shop's US results page for a keyword (up to about 25). First page only. A keyword with no results page returns 404 at 0 credits, and an empty page costs 0 credits. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Costs 0 credits when products is empty. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

page.description: Only 1 is accepted: later pages are not available.

query.description: Keyword to search for, such as shoes or running shoes.

name: tiktok_shop_search
